# CAREER JOURNAL 1.0.5

Archived materials now keep readable filenames such as `Disney-Haowen Chen.pdf`. CAREER JOURNAL no longer adds a long SHA-256 prefix to files shown in Finder or another local file manager.

When another version would use the same filename in the same folder, CAREER JOURNAL adds a simple numeric suffix such as `(2)` instead of overwriting the existing file. SHA-256 remains internal for integrity checks and duplicate detection.

---

# CAREER JOURNAL 1.0.5 中文说明

归档材料现在保留容易辨认的文件名，例如 `Disney-Haowen Chen.pdf`。在 Finder 或其他本地文件管理器中，不会再看到一长串 SHA-256 前缀。

如果同一文件夹中出现同名新版本，CAREER JOURNAL 会添加 `(2)` 这样的简单序号，避免覆盖已有文件。SHA-256 仍在系统内部用于完整性校验和重复检测。
